# ankra_ai_anthropic_key (Resource)

The organisation's own Anthropic API key (bring your own key), a singleton: declare it once per organisation. The counterpart of `ankra ai anthropic set` and `ankra ai anthropic delete`. Storing the key does not activate it; set `ankra_ai_provider` for that. Destroying it removes the key, and when Anthropic was the active provider the platform falls back to `ankra`.

The platform never returns the key, so a key replaced outside Terraform is visible only as a changed `key_preview`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ai_anthropic_key" "own" {
  api_key = var.anthropic_api_key
}

variable "anthropic_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) The Anthropic API key; it must start with `sk-ant-`. The platform validates it against Anthropic before storing it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `ai_anthropic_key`.
- `key_preview` (String) Masked preview of the stored key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The Anthropic key is a singleton. The key cannot be read back, so the first
# apply after an import stores the configured key again.
terraform import ankra_ai_anthropic_key.own ai_anthropic_key
```
